lung-tnm9.title: Lung cancer TNM
lung-tnm9.scope: Lung carcinoma; identify invasive/solid size, regional stations and all metastatic sites.

rows.report_note: Measure the solid component of a part-solid lesion; record total size separately.

rows.criteria: >3–4 / >4–5 cm; smaller tumours with qualifying T2 features are T2a.
rows.report_note: T2 features include visceral pleura, adjacent lobe, main bronchus without carina, or hilar-extending atelectasis/pneumonitis.

rows.criteria: >5–7 cm, qualifying chest-wall/parietal pleural/pericardial/phrenic invasion, or same-lobe separate tumour nodule.
rows.report_note: Specify each invaded structure and separate nodule location.

rows.criteria: >7 cm, qualifying mediastinal/major-structure invasion, or separate nodule in another ipsilateral lobe.
rows.report_note: State carina, great vessels, heart, oesophagus, diaphragm or spine involvement.

tables.title: N / M — stations and metastatic sites

rows.criteria: Ipsilateral hilar / peribronchial / intrapulmonary nodes.
rows.report_note: Name stations.

rows.criteria: One / multiple ipsilateral mediastinal or subcarinal stations.
rows.report_note: Count stations, rather than individual nodes.

rows.criteria: Contralateral hilar/mediastinal or scalene/supraclavicular nodes.
rows.report_note: Report laterality and station.

rows.criteria: Contralateral lung nodule, malignant pleural/pericardial nodules or effusion.
rows.report_note: Do not label an indeterminate effusion malignant.

rows.criteria: Single extrathoracic metastasis.
rows.report_note: Name the site.

rows.criteria: Multiple extrathoracic metastases in one / multiple organ systems.
rows.report_note: List organs and burden.

report_fields: Solid and total diameter, lobe and series/image
Node stations, short axes and certainty
limits: Use the highest applicable descriptor; suspicious nodes may need tissue confirmation.
Clinical stage uses all available investigations; CT alone does not establish pathological stage.

illustration.title: Lung cancer TNM — reporting anatomy and pathway
illustration.alt: Lung cancer TNM. Solid size → T1/T2. Apply highest qualifying T feature. Stations → N1/N2a/N2b/N3. Sites → M1a/b/c1/c2
illustration.caption: Original simplified anatomical and reporting schematic. Read with the category table; this is not a clinical case image.

anal-tnm9.title: Anal canal carcinoma TNM
anal-tnm9.scope: Anal canal carcinoma; confirm histology and precise primary site before applying the system.

rows.report_note: Greatest tumour dimension determines size category.

rows.criteria: Adjacent organ invasion.
rows.report_note: Name vagina, urethra or bladder; sphincter involvement alone is insufficient.

rows.criteria: Inguinal, mesorectal or internal iliac nodes.
rows.report_note: Map each basin and side.

rows.criteria: External iliac nodes.
rows.report_note: Record side and morphology.

rows.criteria: External iliac plus an N1a basin.
rows.report_note: Describe both distributions.

rows.criteria: Distant metastasis.
rows.report_note: Nonregional nodes and distant organs; state coverage.

report_fields: Regional nodal basins and distant findings
limits: Size-based T staging differs from rectal wall-depth staging.
Report cT/cN findings and confidence; complete stage grouping uses the adopted Version 9 protocol.

illustration.title: Anal canal carcinoma TNM — reporting anatomy and pathway
illustration.alt: Anal canal carcinoma TNM. Measure ≤2 / >2–5 / >5 cm. Adjacent organ → T4. Map pelvic and inguinal basins. Separate regional from distant spread
illustration.caption: Original simplified anatomical and reporting schematic. Read with the category table; this is not a clinical case image.

rectal-tnm.title: Rectal adenocarcinoma TNM and MRI risk features
rectal-tnm.version: AJCC 8 anatomical descriptors; ESGAR / 2026 reporting reference
rectal-tnm.scope: Baseline MRI local staging and post-treatment MRI restaging; state c versus yc prefix.

rows.criteria: Submucosa / muscularis propria.
rows.report_note: MRI may not reliably separate T1 from T2.

rows.criteria: Beyond muscularis propria into mesorectal tissue.
rows.report_note: Measure extramural depth in mm; record MRF distance separately.

rows.criteria: Visceral peritoneal invasion.
rows.report_note: Identify the peritoneal reflection; MRF involvement alone is not T4a.

rows.criteria: Adjacent organ or structure invasion.
rows.report_note: Name the actual structure; distinguish contact/desmoplasia from convincing invasion.

rows.criteria: 1–3 involved regional nodes; N1c denotes deposits without positive regional nodes.
rows.report_note: Use morphology and size criteria; deposits/EMVI are separate observations.

rows.criteria: 4–6 / ≥7 involved regional nodes.
rows.report_note: Do not convert uncertain MRI nodes to pathological counts.

rows.criteria: One distant organ/site / ≥2 organs/sites / peritoneal metastases with or without other sites.
rows.report_note: Pelvic MRI does not complete distant staging.

rows.criteria: MRF distance, EMVI, extramural depth and lateral pelvic nodes.
rows.report_note: Record each independently of TNM.

report_fields: Extramural depth and shortest MRF distance in mm
Sphincter/levator involvement; yc stage and response if treated
limits: Do not label MRF involvement as T4.
Restaging fibrosis and viable tumour can overlap; use DWI and morphology with uncertainty.

illustration.title: Rectal adenocarcinoma TNM and MRI risk features — reporting anatomy and pathway
illustration.alt: Rectal adenocarcinoma TNM and MRI risk features. Wall → T1/T2. Beyond muscle → T3. Peritoneum / organ → T4a/b. MRF + EMVI + lateral nodes
illustration.caption: Original simplified anatomical and reporting schematic. Read with the category table; this is not a clinical case image.

cervix-figo.title: Cervical carcinoma FIGO
cervix-figo.version: FIGO 2018 with corrected IB size boundaries (2019 / 2021 reference)
cervix-figo.scope: Integrate imaging with examination and pathology; append r for imaging-based nodal staging.

rows.criteria: Microscopic invasive disease, depth ≤5 mm.
rows.report_note: Requires pathology; MRI does not diagnose microinvasion.

rows.criteria: Confined cervix; ≤2 / >2–4 / >4 cm.
rows.report_note: Record maximum dimension and preserved stroma.

rows.criteria: Upper two-thirds vaginal involvement without parametria; ≤4 / >4 cm.
rows.report_note: Map vaginal extent.

rows.criteria: Parametrial invasion.
rows.report_note: Describe side and ureteric relationship.

rows.criteria: Lower-third vagina / pelvic wall or tumour-related hydronephrosis/nonfunctioning kidney.
rows.report_note: Describe wall and urinary obstruction.

rows.criteria: Bladder or rectal mucosal invasion.
rows.report_note: Bullous oedema alone is insufficient; confirmation may be required.

rows.criteria: Pelvic / para-aortic nodal metastases on imaging.
rows.report_note: Report local extent as well as nodal stage.

rows.criteria: Distant metastases.
rows.report_note: Name sites and examination limits.

report_fields: Maximum size and residual stromal rim
Parametria, vaginal thirds and pelvic wall
limits: Keep 2018 FIGO distinct from older size cutoffs.
A nodal stage does not replace a description of local surgical/radiotherapy anatomy.

illustration.title: Cervical carcinoma FIGO — reporting anatomy and pathway
illustration.alt: Cervical carcinoma FIGO. Cervix + size → IB. Vagina / parametria → II. Wall / lower vagina / nodes → III. Mucosa / distant sites → IV
illustration.caption: Original simplified anatomical and reporting schematic. Read with the category table; this is not a clinical case image.

endometrium-figo2023.title: Endometrial carcinoma FIGO
endometrium-figo2023.scope: Imaging supplies anatomical extent; final stage integrates histology, LVSI and molecular findings.

rows.criteria: Nonaggressive type: endometrium/polyp only / <50% myometrial invasion with no or focal LVSI.
rows.report_note: Report invasion depth and remaining myometrium.

rows.criteria: Selected low-grade endometrioid uterine and ovarian disease meeting pathological criteria.
rows.report_note: Imaging alone cannot confirm eligibility.

rows.criteria: Nonaggressive type, ≥50% myometrial invasion; no/focal LVSI.
rows.report_note: Report percentage and deepest site.

rows.criteria: Aggressive type confined to endometrium/polyp.
rows.report_note: Histology is required.

rows.criteria: Nonaggressive type with cervical stroma / substantial LVSI / aggressive type with myometrial invasion.
rows.report_note: LVSI and molecular modifiers require pathology.

rows.criteria: Adnexa / uterine serosa or subserosa.
rows.report_note: Describe separately.

rows.criteria: Vagina/parametria / pelvic peritoneum.
rows.report_note: Map extent.

rows.criteria: Pelvic / para-aortic nodes up to renal vessels.
rows.report_note: Micrometastatic versus macrometastatic suffixes need pathology.

rows.criteria: Bladder/bowel mucosa / extrapelvic peritoneum / distant metastases.
rows.report_note: Specify organs and nodal level.

report_fields: Nodes by level and distant sites
limits: Do not assign FIGO 2023 from MRI anatomy alone.
POLEmut and p53abn modifiers can alter early-stage classification; record available pathology separately.

illustration.title: Endometrial carcinoma FIGO — reporting anatomy and pathway
illustration.alt: Endometrial carcinoma FIGO. Myometrial depth: <50 / ≥50%. Cervical stroma + extrauterine sites. Pelvic / para-aortic nodes. Histology + LVSI + molecular → final FIGO
illustration.caption: Original simplified anatomical and reporting schematic. Read with the category table; this is not a clinical case image.

pancreas-tnm.title: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma TNM
pancreas-tnm.scope: Use for ductal/exocrine carcinoma; neuroendocrine tumours use a separate framework.

rows.report_note: Record greatest dimension.

rows.criteria: Coeliac axis, SMA and/or common hepatic artery involvement, regardless of size.
rows.report_note: Describe artery, contact angle, length and contour; multidisciplinary interpretation is required.

rows.criteria: 1–3 / ≥4 involved regional nodes.
rows.report_note: Pathological counts differ from suspicious CT nodes.

rows.criteria: Distant metastasis.
rows.report_note: Name liver, peritoneum, lung or nonregional nodes.

rows.criteria: Separate from TNM.
rows.report_note: Report arterial/venous contact, narrowing/occlusion, thrombus, reconstructible segments and variant anatomy.

report_fields: Tumour size and pancreatic/bile duct obstruction
SMV/PV contact, occlusion, thrombus and collaterals
Nodes, metastatic sites and treatment history
limits: A TNM category alone does not establish resectability.
Residual soft tissue after therapy can overestimate viable vascular invasion.

illustration.title: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma TNM — reporting anatomy and pathway
illustration.alt: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma TNM. Size → T1/T2/T3. CA / SMA / CHA involvement → T4. Map venous/arterial contact separately. Distant sites + resectability discussion
illustration.caption: Original simplified anatomical and reporting schematic. Read with the category table; this is not a clinical case image.

renal-tnm.title: Renal cell carcinoma TNM
renal-tnm.scope: Solid renal carcinoma; Bosniak is a cystic-mass risk classification rather than cancer stage.

rows.criteria: Kidney-confined, ≤4 / >4–7 cm.
rows.report_note: Measure maximum diameter.

rows.criteria: Kidney-confined, >7–10 / >10 cm.
rows.report_note: Document confinement.

rows.criteria: Renal vein/segmental venous branches, collecting system, renal sinus or perirenal fat; not beyond Gerota fascia.
rows.report_note: Separate venous thrombus from bland thrombus.

rows.criteria: IVC below diaphragm / above diaphragm or IVC wall invasion.
rows.report_note: Give upper thrombus level and wall findings.

rows.criteria: Beyond Gerota fascia, including contiguous ipsilateral adrenal invasion.
rows.report_note: Distinguish separate adrenal metastasis.

rows.criteria: Regional nodes / distant disease.
rows.report_note: State sites and certainty.

report_fields: Size, kidney pole and hilar relation
Venous thrombus upper limit and IVC wall
Nodes, adrenal findings and distant metastases
limits: Loss of a fat plane alone does not prove invasion.
Do not apply RCC staging to all renal tumour histologies.

illustration.title: Renal cell carcinoma TNM — reporting anatomy and pathway
illustration.alt: Renal cell carcinoma TNM. Confined + size → T1/T2. Vein / sinus / fat → T3a. IVC level / wall → T3b/c. Beyond Gerota → T4
illustration.caption: Original simplified anatomical and reporting schematic. Read with the category table; this is not a clinical case image.

prostate-local.title: Prostate carcinoma: imaging extent and TNM
prostate-local.scope: Report MRI local extent separately from DRE-based cT used in EAU risk groups; PI-RADS expresses suspicion.

rows.criteria: No convincing extraprostatic extension.
rows.report_note: Do not infer cT1/T2 substage solely from MRI.

rows.criteria: Extraprostatic extension.
rows.report_note: Record location, extent and neurovascular bundle involvement.

rows.criteria: Seminal vesicle invasion.
rows.report_note: State side and extent.

rows.criteria: Adjacent structures other than seminal vesicles.
rows.report_note: Name external sphincter, rectum, levators or pelvic wall.

rows.criteria: Regional pelvic nodes.
rows.report_note: Give basin and short axis.

rows.criteria: Nonregional nodes / bone / other sites.
rows.report_note: State staging coverage and modality.

report_fields: Pelvic nodes; distant findings only within assessed coverage
limits: MRI does not supply PSA, grade group or DRE-based clinical T.
PSMA miTNM is distinct from conventional TNM.

illustration.title: Prostate carcinoma: imaging extent and TNM — reporting anatomy and pathway
illustration.alt: Prostate carcinoma: imaging extent and TNM. PI-RADS → suspicion. Capsule / neurovascular bundle → EPE. Seminal vesicle → T3b-equivalent. DRE + PSA + histology → clinical risk
illustration.caption: Original simplified anatomical and reporting schematic. Read with the category table; this is not a clinical case image.

breast-tnm.title: Breast carcinoma anatomical TNM
breast-tnm.scope: Invasive breast cancer. Prognostic stage additionally requires grade and ER/PR/HER2.

rows.report_note: Microinvasion is pathological; imaging estimates invasive extent.
Use largest invasive focus, describe multifocal span separately.

rows.criteria: Chest wall / qualifying skin findings / both / inflammatory carcinoma.
rows.report_note: Pectoralis invasion alone is not chest-wall T4a; T4d requires clinical assessment.

rows.criteria: Movable ipsilateral level I/II axillary nodes.
rows.report_note: Mobility requires examination; describe imaging suspicion.

rows.criteria: Fixed/matted axillary nodes or clinically detected internal mammary nodes without axillary involvement.
rows.report_note: Distinguish clinical descriptors from pathology counts.

rows.criteria: Infraclavicular, combined axillary/internal mammary, or supraclavicular regional spread.
rows.report_note: Map basin and level.

rows.criteria: Distant metastases.
rows.report_note: Breast MRI cannot exclude disease outside its field.

report_fields: Index tumour size; focality and overall span
Axillary levels, internal mammary and supraclavicular nodes
limits: BI-RADS assessment is not a stage.
Do not sum separate invasive foci to derive T; prognostic stage needs biomarkers and grade.

illustration.title: Breast carcinoma anatomical TNM — reporting anatomy and pathway
illustration.alt: Breast carcinoma anatomical TNM. Largest invasive focus → size T. Qualifying skin / chest wall → T4. Axillary + IM + SC basins → N. Grade + ER/PR/HER2 → prognostic stage
illustration.caption: Original simplified anatomical and reporting schematic. Read with the category table; this is not a clinical case image.

ovarian-figo.title: Ovarian, tubal and primary peritoneal carcinoma FIGO
ovarian-figo.scope: Confirmed epithelial ovarian/tubal/peritoneal malignancy; image anatomy and surgical/pathological staging complement each other.

rows.criteria: Confined ovaries/tubes; IC1 surgical spill, IC2 preoperative rupture/surface tumour, IC3 positive washings/ascites.
rows.report_note: Imaging cannot confirm cytology or surgical spill.

rows.criteria: Uterus/tubes/ovaries / other pelvic intraperitoneal extension.
rows.report_note: Map pelvic organs.

rows.criteria: Retroperitoneal nodes only / microscopic extrapelvic peritoneal disease.
rows.report_note: Microscopic stage requires pathology.

rows.criteria: Macroscopic extrapelvic peritoneal deposits ≤2 / >2 cm.
rows.report_note: Measure largest deposit; liver/splenic capsule differs from parenchymal spread.

rows.criteria: Cytology-positive pleural effusion / parenchymal or other distant disease.
rows.report_note: Effusion alone cannot establish IVA.

report_fields: Adnexal mass, laterality and solid extent
limits: O-RADS is a risk score; use FIGO only after establishing malignancy.
Different primary tumours have different staging systems for peritoneal disease.

illustration.title: Ovarian, tubal and primary peritoneal carcinoma FIGO — reporting anatomy and pathway
illustration.alt: Ovarian, tubal and primary peritoneal carcinoma FIGO. Adnexal only → I. Pelvic extension → II. Extrapelvic peritoneum / nodes → III. Pleural cytology / distant organs → IV
illustration.caption: Original simplified anatomical and reporting schematic. Read with the category table; this is not a clinical case image.

liver-bclc.title: Hepatocellular carcinoma BCLC
liver-bclc.scope: Known HCC; staging incorporates tumour burden, liver function and performance status.

rows.criteria: Single ≤2 cm lesion, preserved liver function, performance status 0.
rows.report_note: Record lesion size and vascular invasion.

rows.criteria: Single lesion or ≤3 nodules each ≤3 cm; preserved function, PS 0.
rows.report_note: Document count and largest size.

rows.criteria: Multifocal disease beyond A, no vascular invasion/extrahepatic spread; PS 0 and preserved function.
rows.report_note: Map burden and distribution.

rows.criteria: Vascular invasion or extrahepatic spread, PS ≤2 with preserved liver function.
rows.report_note: Specify vessel, tumour thrombus and distant sites.

rows.criteria: PS >2 and/or severely impaired liver function without transplant option.
rows.report_note: Requires clinical assessment.

report_fields: Available liver function, PS and treatment history
limits: LI-RADS categorises observations; it is not a cancer stage.
CT/MRI cannot supply all BCLC inputs.

illustration.title: Hepatocellular carcinoma BCLC — reporting anatomy and pathway
illustration.alt: Hepatocellular carcinoma BCLC. Count + size + distribution. Tumour-in-vein + extrahepatic spread. Liver function + performance status. Multidisciplinary → BCLC
illustration.caption: Original simplified anatomical and reporting schematic. Read with the category table; this is not a clinical case image.

bladder-tnm.title: Bladder urothelial carcinoma: TNM and VI-RADS
bladder-tnm.scope: Pretreatment bladder MRI; record prior TURBT/therapy and bladder distension.

rows.criteria: Noninvasive papillary / flat in-situ / subepithelial connective tissue.
rows.report_note: Histology/endoscopy required.

rows.criteria: Inner / outer muscularis propria.
rows.report_note: MRI evaluates muscle invasion; microscopic depth subdivision is difficult.

rows.criteria: Microscopic / macroscopic perivesical tissue.
rows.report_note: Perivesical inflammatory change after TURBT may mimic invasion.

rows.criteria: Prostatic stroma, seminal vesicles, uterus or vagina / pelvic or abdominal wall.
rows.report_note: Name organ and route.

rows.criteria: Single true-pelvic / multiple true-pelvic / common iliac nodes.
rows.report_note: Give basin and number of suspicious nodes.

rows.criteria: Nonregional nodes / other distant sites.
rows.report_note: State coverage.

rows.criteria: Muscle invasion highly unlikely.
rows.report_note: A likelihood score, separate from TNM.

rows.criteria: Unlikely.
rows.report_note: A likelihood score, separate from TNM.

rows.criteria: Equivocal.
rows.report_note: A likelihood score, separate from TNM.

rows.criteria: Likely.
rows.report_note: A likelihood score, separate from TNM.

rows.criteria: Muscle invasion and extension outside bladder very likely.
rows.report_note: A likelihood score, separate from TNM.

report_fields: Nodes by basin; distant disease and TURBT timing
limits: Do not equate VI-RADS 5 with a specific TNM stage.
Final stage and microscopic categories need pathology.

illustration.title: Bladder urothelial carcinoma: TNM and VI-RADS — reporting anatomy and pathway
illustration.alt: Bladder urothelial carcinoma: TNM and VI-RADS. Mucosa / lamina propria → tissue. Muscularis → T2 likelihood. Perivesical / adjacent organs → T3/T4. VI-RADS ≠ final TNM
illustration.caption: Original simplified anatomical and reporting schematic. Read with the category table; this is not a clinical case image.

small-bowel-tnm.title: Small-bowel adenocarcinoma TNM
small-bowel-tnm.scope: Adenocarcinoma only; GIST, neuroendocrine tumour and lymphoma require their own systems.

rows.criteria: Lamina propria/submucosa / muscularis propria.
rows.report_note: CT cannot reliably resolve early wall layers.

rows.criteria: Through muscle into subserosa or nonperitonealised perimuscular tissues without serosal penetration.
rows.report_note: Describe mesenteric extension.

rows.criteria: Visceral peritoneal perforation or direct invasion of other organs/structures.
rows.report_note: Name invaded organ; duodenal invasion of pancreas/bile duct qualifies.

rows.criteria: 1–2 / ≥3 involved regional nodes.
rows.report_note: Imaging suspicion differs from tissue-confirmed counts.

rows.criteria: Distant disease.
rows.report_note: Report peritoneal and organ metastases.

limits: Do not apply adenocarcinoma TNM to lymphoma, GIST or NET.

illustration.title: Small-bowel adenocarcinoma TNM — reporting anatomy and pathway
illustration.alt: Small-bowel adenocarcinoma TNM. Confirm histology. Wall / mesentery / organ invasion. Regional nodes by location. Peritoneum and distant organs
illustration.caption: Original simplified anatomical and reporting schematic. Read with the category table; this is not a clinical case image.

esophagus-tnm.title: Oesophageal carcinoma TNM
esophagus-tnm.scope: Histology, location and treatment phase influence stage grouping.

rows.criteria: Mucosa / submucosa / muscularis propria.
rows.report_note: EUS/pathology improves early wall-layer staging.

rows.criteria: Adventitia.
rows.report_note: Describe local soft-tissue extent.

rows.criteria: Pleura, pericardium, azygos, diaphragm or peritoneum.
rows.report_note: Name invaded structure.

rows.criteria: Other major adjacent structures, such as aorta, vertebra or airway.
rows.report_note: Contact alone is insufficient.

rows.criteria: 1–2 / 3–6 / ≥7 involved regional nodes.
rows.report_note: Map nodal stations; imaging counts are estimates.

rows.criteria: Distant spread.
rows.report_note: Name sites.

report_fields: Epicentre relative to GE junction and longitudinal length
limits: A preserved/lost fat plane is not a stand-alone invasion test.
Do not derive the complete prognostic stage group from CT alone.

illustration.title: Oesophageal carcinoma TNM — reporting anatomy and pathway
illustration.alt: Oesophageal carcinoma TNM. Length + epicentre + histology. Wall depth: EUS / pathology. Adjacent structures: CT/MRI. Nodes + distant sites
illustration.caption: Original simplified anatomical and reporting schematic. Read with the category table; this is not a clinical case image.

thymic-tnm9.title: Thymic epithelial tumour TNM
thymic-tnm9.scope: Thymoma and thymic carcinoma; keep TNM separate from pathological Masaoka–Koga staging.

sources.title: IASLC staging manual / thymic TNM ninth edition

rows.criteria: No higher-level invasion; ≤5 / >5 cm.
rows.report_note: Describe mediastinal fat/pleural interfaces.

rows.criteria: Pericardium, lung or phrenic nerve invasion.
rows.report_note: These invasion descriptors differ from TNM 8.

rows.criteria: Brachiocephalic vein, SVC, chest wall or extrapericardial pulmonary vessels.
rows.report_note: Name structure and length of contact/invasion.

rows.criteria: Aorta/arch vessels, intrapericardial pulmonary vessels, myocardium, trachea or oesophagus.
rows.report_note: Contact alone does not prove invasion.

rows.criteria: Anterior/perithymic / deep intrathoracic or cervical nodes.
rows.report_note: Map compartments.

rows.criteria: Pleural/pericardial nodules / pulmonary intraparenchymal or distant metastasis.
rows.report_note: Specify distribution.

report_fields: Pleural/pericardial nodules; nodes and distant disease
limits: Masaoka–Koga includes operative/pathological inputs.
Use the stated edition; T1 and T2 definitions changed in the ninth edition.

illustration.title: Thymic epithelial tumour TNM — reporting anatomy and pathway
illustration.alt: Thymic epithelial tumour TNM. Size ≤5 / >5 cm → T1. Pericardium / lung / phrenic → T2. Venous / chest-wall → T3. Major structures → T4
illustration.caption: Original simplified anatomical and reporting schematic. Read with the category table; this is not a clinical case image.

head-neck-frameworks.title: Head and neck cancer: choose the site-specific stage
head-neck-frameworks.version: AJCC site-specific systems: 8th edition and phased Version 9 updates
head-neck-frameworks.scope: Determine primary subsite, histology and HPV/EBV status before using T/N criteria.

rows.criteria: Site-specific TNM; size and depth of invasion matter.
rows.report_note: Describe DOI estimate, mandible/maxilla, extrinsic muscles and skin.

rows.criteria: AJCC Version 9 (2026).
rows.report_note: Document primary subsite, HPV evidence, nodal laterality/size and imaging ENE; use the linked current protocol.

rows.criteria: Separate site-specific TNM.
rows.report_note: Do not reuse HPV-associated N rules; map invasion and ENE.

rows.criteria: Subsite-specific TNM.
rows.report_note: Map pre-epiglottic/paraglottic spaces, cartilage and extralaryngeal extension; mobility needs clinical assessment.

rows.criteria: Version 9 updates; use named current protocol.
rows.report_note: Nasopharynx: skull base, nerves, intracranial extent. Salivary: size, extraparenchymal spread, nerve and skin.

rows.criteria: Level, side, size, necrosis and suspected ENE.
rows.report_note: Imaging ENE is separate from pathological ENE; stage cannot be assigned from a generic neck table.
Measure greatest dimension; confirm HPV-associated primary subsite.

rows.criteria: >4 cm or lingual epiglottic surface extension.
rows.report_note: Mucosal spread to epiglottis alone does not prove laryngeal invasion.

rows.criteria: Qualifying invasion of larynx, deep tongue muscles, pterygoids, hard palate, mandible, pterygoid plates, nasopharynx, skull base or carotid encasement.
rows.report_note: Name each invaded structure.

rows.criteria: Record side, size, node number/distribution and imaging-detected ENE.
rows.report_note: Use the clinical N protocol; pathological ENE/count categories cannot be substituted for imaging N.

report_fields: Primary subsite and size; DOI where appropriate
Nodal level, side, short axis, necrosis and suspected ENE
Distant sites and missing clinical/biological inputs
limits: A single generic head/neck TNM table would give incorrect categories across subsites.
The current CAP protocols linked here provide the complete site-specific definitions.
The additional T table applies only to HPV-associated oropharyngeal carcinoma; use the subsite selector table for other primaries.

illustration.title: Head and neck cancer: choose the site-specific stage — reporting anatomy and pathway
illustration.alt: Head and neck cancer: choose the site-specific stage. Primary subsite + histology. HPV / EBV + named version. Local invasion + nodal levels/ENE. Apply the matching site protocol
illustration.caption: Original simplified anatomical and reporting schematic. Read with the category table; this is not a clinical case image.

bone-enneking.title: Malignant bone tumours: Enneking / MSTS
bone-enneking.scope: Primary musculoskeletal malignancy; histological grade and tumour-specific treatment pathways are required.

rows.criteria: Low grade, intracompartmental / extracompartmental; no metastases.
rows.report_note: Map cortical breach and soft-tissue extension.

rows.criteria: High grade, intracompartmental / extracompartmental; no metastases.
rows.report_note: Grade requires histology.

rows.criteria: Regional or distant metastases.
rows.report_note: Report skip lesions, nodes and distant organs explicitly.

rows.criteria: Entire involved bone, joint, neurovascular bundles and biopsy tract.
rows.report_note: Give length, compartment, skip lesions and surgical interfaces.

rows.criteria: Lung and other metastatic sites using tumour-specific protocol.
rows.report_note: Paediatric osteosarcoma pathways often use localised/metastatic status rather than AJCC stage groups.

report_fields: Bone segment, length and soft-tissue component
Skip lesions; lung and other metastases
limits: Do not infer histological grade from aggressive MRI appearance.
AJCC criteria differ for appendicular skeleton, pelvis and spine; specify site-specific system when used.

illustration.title: Malignant bone tumours: Enneking / MSTS — reporting anatomy and pathway
illustration.alt: Malignant bone tumours: Enneking / MSTS. Histology → low/high grade. Intra / extracompartmental extent. Skip lesions and metastases. Combine → Enneking stage
illustration.caption: Original simplified anatomical and reporting schematic. Read with the category table; this is not a clinical case image.

cns-classification.title: Primary CNS tumours: integrated diagnosis and extent
cns-classification.scope: Primary adult CNS tumours generally have no conventional TNM stage.

rows.criteria: Histology and molecular markers determine classification.
rows.report_note: MRI describes extent; it cannot independently assign an integrated WHO diagnosis.

rows.criteria: Enhancing and nonenhancing components, eloquent structures and mass effect.
rows.report_note: Record dimensions and relevant T2/FLAIR extent.

rows.criteria: Multifocal, leptomeningeal or CSF-axis disease.
rows.report_note: Use tumour-specific brain/spine/CSF work-up where indicated.

rows.criteria: RANO or other appropriate protocol, rather than generic TNM.
rows.report_note: Document steroids, timing, treatment effects and new lesions.

report_fields: Functional and surgical interfaces; mass effect
limits: Do not convert WHO grade to a TNM stage.
CNS metastases are staged under the known primary cancer; response frameworks have separate scope.

illustration.title: Primary CNS tumours: integrated diagnosis and extent — reporting anatomy and pathway
illustration.alt: Primary CNS tumours: integrated diagnosis and extent. Anatomical extent on MRI. Tissue + molecular diagnosis. Tumour-specific dissemination work-up. Appropriate RANO / treatment context
illustration.caption: Original simplified anatomical and reporting schematic. Read with the category table; this is not a clinical case image.

neuroblastoma-inrg.title: Neuroblastoma INRGSS
neuroblastoma-inrg.scope: Neuroblastoma; document each image-defined risk factor (IDRF).

rows.criteria: Localised, one body compartment, no IDRF.
rows.report_note: Use the complete IDRF checklist.

rows.criteria: Locoregional disease with ≥1 IDRF.
rows.report_note: Name vessel encasement, organ or spinal involvement.

rows.criteria: Distant metastatic disease, except MS.
rows.report_note: State bone, marrow, liver, skin and distant nodes.

rows.criteria: Age <18 months with metastases restricted to skin, liver and/or marrow and qualifying criteria.
rows.report_note: Age, marrow burden and functional imaging eligibility require the full protocol.

report_fields: Metastatic sites and functional imaging findings
limits: INRG stage is not the overall risk group; biology and age matter.
MS is not assigned from liver metastases alone.

illustration.title: Neuroblastoma INRGSS — reporting anatomy and pathway
illustration.alt: Neuroblastoma INRGSS. Any IDRF? → L1 / L2. Distant disease? → M. Age + restricted sites → consider MS. Biology + stage → clinical risk group
illustration.caption: Original simplified anatomical and reporting schematic. Read with the category table; this is not a clinical case image.

wilms-cog.title: Wilms tumour staging
wilms-cog.version: COG / NWTS I–V; distinguish SIOP postchemotherapy staging
wilms-cog.scope: Suspected Wilms tumour; final local stage incorporates surgery and pathology.

rows.criteria: Kidney-confined / extends beyond kidney, completely resected.
rows.report_note: Resection and pathological criteria are required.

rows.criteria: Residual nonhaematogenous abdominal disease or qualifying local surgical/pathological factors.
rows.report_note: Describe nodes, rupture/spill suspicion, peritoneal implants; imaging does not establish margins.

rows.criteria: Haematogenous metastases or distant nodes.
rows.report_note: Give lung/liver/bone/brain sites.

rows.criteria: Bilateral renal tumours at diagnosis.
rows.report_note: Describe and stage each kidney locally in the definitive pathway.

limits: Venous tumour extension is not automatically stage IV.
Use the treating pathway: preoperative chemotherapy changes staging context.

illustration.title: Wilms tumour staging — reporting anatomy and pathway
illustration.alt: Wilms tumour staging. Both kidneys → bilateral V. Vein / IVC extent ≠ distant spread. Nodes / rupture / peritoneum. Surgery + pathology → local I–III
illustration.caption: Original simplified anatomical and reporting schematic. Read with the category table; this is not a clinical case image.

pretext.title: Hepatoblastoma PRETEXT / POSTTEXT
pretext.scope: Childhood liver tumour anatomy before / after therapy; four liver sections, not four arbitrary lobes.

rows.criteria: Three adjoining sections free.
rows.report_note: Name involved section.

rows.criteria: Two adjoining sections free.
rows.report_note: Noncontiguous free sections do not suffice.

rows.criteria: One section free, or two nonadjoining sections free.
rows.report_note: Map all sections.

rows.criteria: No section free.
rows.report_note: All four sections involved.

rows.criteria: V/P venous/portal, E extrahepatic, F multifocal, R rupture, C caudate, N nodes, M metastases.
rows.report_note: State anatomy and exact vascular criteria; use the complete annotation protocol.

report_fields: II/III; IV; V/VIII; VI/VII section involvement
PRETEXT before and POSTTEXT after therapy
limits: The number of involved sections alone can misclassify noncontiguous disease.
Risk group needs age, AFP, histology and clinical inputs.

illustration.title: Hepatoblastoma PRETEXT / POSTTEXT — reporting anatomy and pathway
illustration.alt: Hepatoblastoma PRETEXT / POSTTEXT. Left lateral | left medial. Right anterior | right posterior. Adjoining free sections → I–IV. Add V/P/E/F/R/C/N/M
illustration.caption: Original simplified anatomical and reporting schematic. Read with the category table; this is not a clinical case image.

lymphoma-lugano.title: Lymphoma Lugano extent
lymphoma-lugano.scope: Adult lymphoma; PET/CT is preferred for FDG-avid histologies and tissue diagnosis is required.

rows.criteria: One lymphatic site / single extranodal site without nodes.
rows.report_note: Describe the actual site.

rows.criteria: ≥2 nodal regions on one side of diaphragm; E denotes limited contiguous extranodal extension.
rows.report_note: Map regions and contiguous organ extension.

rows.criteria: Nodes on both sides of diaphragm, including qualifying splenic distribution.
rows.report_note: Document spleen findings.

rows.criteria: Disseminated/noncontiguous extranodal disease.
rows.report_note: Specify organs, marrow and distribution.

rows.criteria: Record bulk separately; response uses appropriate PET/CT criteria.
rows.report_note: Do not equate Deauville score with stage.

report_fields: Largest mass dimensions and baseline comparison
limits: Paediatric lymphoma staging may use a different system.
PET avidity and clinical symptoms cannot be inferred from CT alone.

illustration.title: Lymphoma Lugano extent — reporting anatomy and pathway
illustration.alt: Lymphoma Lugano extent. One region → I. Same side of diaphragm → II. Both sides → III. Disseminated extranodal → IV
illustration.caption: Original simplified anatomical and reporting schematic. Read with the category table; this is not a clinical case image.

recist11.title: Solid-tumour response: RECIST
recist11.scope: Response assessment, separate from cancer stage; follow the specified clinical/trial protocol.

rows.criteria: Up to 5 overall, ≤2 per organ; nonnodal ≥10 mm, nodal short axis ≥15 mm on appropriate CT.
rows.report_note: Use repeatable lesions and technique.

rows.criteria: All target lesions disappear; nodes <10 mm short axis.
rows.report_note: Overall CR also requires non-target/new-lesion assessment.

rows.criteria: Sum decreases ≥30% from baseline.
rows.report_note: Use baseline denominator.

rows.criteria: Sum increases ≥20% from nadir and ≥5 mm absolute; new/unequivocally progressive disease affects overall result.
rows.report_note: Use nadir denominator.

rows.criteria: Neither PR nor PD.
rows.report_note: Integrate non-target and new disease.

report_fields: Baseline, nadir and current target sum
limits: RECIST is not TNM stage.
Use iRECIST or another protocol only when appropriate; record confirmation requirements separately.

illustration.title: Solid-tumour response: RECIST — reporting anatomy and pathway
illustration.alt: Solid-tumour response: RECIST. Select reproducible targets. Compare with baseline → PR. Compare with nadir → PD. Non-target + new lesions → overall response
illustration.caption: Original simplified anatomical and reporting schematic. Read with the category table; this is not a clinical case image.

thyroid-tnm.title: Thyroid carcinoma anatomical TNM
thyroid-tnm.scope: Confirmed thyroid carcinoma; TI-RADS is a nodule risk score, not stage.

rows.criteria: Thyroid-confined; ≤1 / >1–2 / >2–4 cm.
rows.report_note: Measure greatest dimension.

rows.criteria: >4 cm but confined / gross strap-muscle invasion.
rows.report_note: Microscopic extrathyroidal extension is not established by ultrasound.

rows.criteria: Gross invasion of subcutaneous tissue, larynx, trachea, oesophagus or recurrent laryngeal nerve.
rows.report_note: Describe named structure and confidence.

rows.criteria: Prevertebral fascia invasion or carotid/mediastinal vessel encasement.
rows.report_note: Map surgical interfaces.

rows.criteria: Central level VI/VII / lateral neck I–V or retropharyngeal nodes.
rows.report_note: Record level and side.

rows.criteria: Distant metastases.
rows.report_note: Papillary/follicular stage groups also depend on age <55 / ≥55; medullary and anaplastic differ.

report_fields: Gross extrathyroidal extension and named structures
limits: Do not apply differentiated-thyroid age-based stage groups to other histologies.

illustration.title: Thyroid carcinoma anatomical TNM — reporting anatomy and pathway
illustration.alt: Thyroid carcinoma anatomical TNM. Confirmed carcinoma + histology. Size / extrathyroidal anatomy. Central vs lateral nodal levels. Age + histology → stage group
illustration.caption: Original simplified anatomical and reporting schematic. Read with the category table; this is not a clinical case image.

adrenal-ensat.title: Adrenocortical carcinoma ENSAT
adrenal-ensat.scope: Confirmed adrenocortical carcinoma; adrenal adenoma characterisation and pheochromocytoma staging are separate.

rows.criteria: ≤5 cm, adrenal-confined, N0M0.
rows.report_note: Give size and local interfaces.

rows.criteria: >5 cm, adrenal-confined, N0M0.
rows.report_note: Describe tumour burden.

rows.criteria: Local infiltration/adjacent-organ invasion or regional nodal disease, M0.
rows.report_note: Describe renal vein/IVC thrombus and organ invasion.

rows.criteria: Distant metastases.
rows.report_note: Name sites; use ENSAT rather than silently mixing an older AJCC stage-group definition.

limits: Imaging does not prove adrenocortical histology or hormone function.

illustration.title: Adrenocortical carcinoma ENSAT — reporting anatomy and pathway
illustration.alt: Adrenocortical carcinoma ENSAT. Adrenal confined + size → I/II. Local / venous / nodal extension → III. Distant metastases → IV. Histology + endocrine assessment
illustration.caption: Original simplified anatomical and reporting schematic. Read with the category table; this is not a clinical case image.
